user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features and answers.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits web pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.opt_out: Not specified.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Content used in training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform user-initiated actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Visits initiated by user questions or interactions via GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply due to user initiation.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to enhance utility and safety by training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Public web content gathered for model development and generative AI training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content to support user-initiated queries to Claude.
user_agents.scope: Websites accessed through user-directed web search and individual questions asked to Claude.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates and analyzes online content to improve search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Online content indexed to enhance relevance and accuracy of user search results.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet for search.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search integrated in Apple products and provides training/context data for Apple models.
user_agents.scope: Webpages crawled for search results, context generation, and AI foundation model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls training of Apple foundation models powering generative AI features.
user_agents.scope: Determines how data crawled by Applebot is used; does not crawl webpages directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls shared content to gather, cache, and display information.
user_agents.scope: App or website content shared on Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow to robots.txt; may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Online content analyzed to enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and business-related products.
user_agents.scope: Web content for advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models or indexing content.
user_agents.scope: Web content for training foundation AI models and product indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request to support agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links requested by users to help AI complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because fetches are requested by users.

user_agents.name: bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages for Bing search and Microsoft Copilot.
user_agents.scope: Discovered public web pages for Bing search indexing and Copilot responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directives in robots.txt for user-agent bingbot.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates page snapshots and previews in real time.
user_agents.scope: Web pages requested for preview generation across Bing and Microsoft services.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directives in robots.txt for user-agent BingPreview.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls host-level web pages to provide information and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amazonbot in robots.txt or use noarchive, noindex, or none meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services such as Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content for search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amzn-SearchBot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetches live web information to support user actions like Alexa queries.
user_agents.scope: Fetches live web content on user behalf; does not crawl for generative AI.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Web crawler providing open web data for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset of the web for public datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: CCBot Disallow: / in robots.txt or request opt-out registry addition.
